title: Lighting a votive candle
framing: guided, explanatory, no scores or win states
intro: A votive candle is lit before a statue, image or shrine as a private devotion. This walkthrough explains what happens and what the practice is understood to mean, from Catholic reference works. It is an explanation, not a prayer made on your behalf.

sources.cite: "Candles", The Catholic Encyclopedia, vol. 3 (New York: Robert Appleton, 1908). New Advent.
